title: Have Thine own way, Lord
lyrics: Thou art the Potter; I am the [Eb]clay.
Mold me and make me [Eb7]after Thy [Ab]will,
Search me and try me, Master, [Eb]today!
Whiter than snow, Lord, [Eb7]wash me just [Ab]now,
Wounded and weary Help me, I [Eb]pray!
Fill with Thy Spirit [Eb7]till all shall [Ab]see
artist: George C. Stebbins, Adelaide A. Pollard
